execution_policy: One primary review task and at most one bivariate task, serially under existing locks. Remaining budget is reserve, not permission for automatic expansion.

priorities.title: Replay the transferred compact hypot table
priorities.reason: Transfer digests verified; serial generator comparison P7 finished.
priorities.next_action: Review dependencies and replay the supplied family table from a clean Linux directory with one deliberately corrupted row.
priorities.deliverable: Standalone verifier, table receipt and negative control, or the precise missing dependency.
priorities.acceptance: Verify every supplied row and reject the negative control. Treat completeness regeneration as a separate milestone.
priorities.stop: Stop at the card budget, missing comparable baseline, or a superseding change.
priorities.dependency: One free bivariate slot and the verified portable archive.
priorities.change: The recovered archive has ten verified transfer digests. P7 found no lost serial sample.

priorities.title: Check the compiled Clang v3 asin refinement graph
priorities.reason: The exact GCC v3 graph and strict model have range evidence. A different compiler may choose different fused operations.
priorities.next_action: Compare one pinned Clang v3 fast listing with both reviewed graphs. Map the high/residual operations and replay the applicable enclosure.
priorities.deliverable: Compiler fingerprint and a mapped enclosure or first unbound instruction.
priorities.acceptance: Show which operations match or differ; bind square-root assumptions and the final exponent input. Stop if the only new result is identical operation order.
priorities.stop: Stop at the card budget, unbound operation, or a changed source.
priorities.dependency: Pinned source, supported x86-64-v3 Clang toolchain and the reviewed interval primitives.
priorities.change: P8 completed its named GCC build. No compiler bug reported.

priorities.title: Exact bivariate regressions: move beyond the two hypot midpoint families
priorities.reason: Both sides of the restricted hypot midpoint now have small certified examples. Preserve the separate archive replay work and try a different pow hypothesis.
priorities.next_action: Design an exact comparator for positive normal pow(x,3/2) by comparing x cubed with squared dyadic rounding boundaries. First certify a bounded sample and controls; no general pow runner qualification or altered exponent sweep.
priorities.deliverable: One bounded exact pow reference sample, or a precise feasibility limit. Keep angular/import checkpoints separate.
priorities.acceptance: Exact input decoding, positive/negative controls and bounds; values, flags and errno separate. Table verification does not regenerate a completeness census. No new bug or novelty claim from a hard-but-correct case.
priorities.stop: Stop at the card budget or on a failed control. Keep archive replay and full-corpus angular comparison as separate milestones.
priorities.dependency: P10 has first use of the single bivariate slot. Qualify any future pow adapter separately.
priorities.change: P7 finished. P10 now has the bivariate slot; the exact comparator stays queued.
